{
  "candidate_rtl": "module comparator_16bit (
    input [15:0] A,
    input [15:0] B,
    output gt,
    output eq,
    output lt
);
    wire [15:0] same;
    wire [15:0] greater;
    wire [15:0] less;
    wire [3:0] group_eq;
    wire [3:0] group_gt;
    wire [3:0] group_lt;

    assign same = ~(A ^ B);
    assign greater = A & ~B;
    assign less = ~A & B;

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < 4; k = k + 1) begin : groups
            assign group_eq[k] = &same[4*k +: 4];
            assign group_gt[k] = greater[4*k+3]
                | (same[4*k+3] & greater[4*k+2])
                | (same[4*k+3] & same[4*k+2] & greater[4*k+1])
                | (same[4*k+3] & same[4*k+2] & same[4*k+1] & greater[4*k]);
            assign group_lt[k] = less[4*k+3]
                | (same[4*k+3] & less[4*k+2])
                | (same[4*k+3] & same[4*k+2] & less[4*k+1])
                | (same[4*k+3] & same[4*k+2] & same[4*k+1] & less[4*k]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign eq = &group_eq;
    assign gt = group_gt[3]
        | (group_eq[3] & group_gt[2])
        | (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_gt[1])
        | (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_eq[1] & group_gt[0]);
    assign lt = group_lt[3]
        | (group_eq[3] & group_lt[2])
        | (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_lt[1])
        | (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_eq[1] & group_lt[0]);
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline has a 0.88 ns maximum arrival at gt, with substantial delay in the mapped comparison and shared equality logic. The lt path also traverses several dependent logic stages.",
  "rewrite": "Use four parallel 4-bit comparison groups followed by explicit lookahead combination. Share bit-equality signals between both comparison directions, but compute gt and lt independently so neither output waits for inversion of the other comparison result.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The two-level grouped lookahead is intended to reduce comparison depth relative to the baseline. A timing improvement is plausible, but its magnitude requires the specified mapping and STA flow; no measured candidate timing is available.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Parallel gt and lt logic trades some duplicated decision logic for shorter paths. Shared bit and group equality signals limit duplication. Mapped area against the 547.775360 um2 cap, and zero slew/capacitance violations, require verification in the specified flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name and unsigned 16-bit input and scalar output interface. For every binary A and B, the highest differing bit determines gt or lt, and eq is asserted exactly when all bits match. There are no parameters, state elements, assumptions, external dependencies, or undefined outputs."
}
